raw_response:
I am thinking about this year like I always do. Let me talk through it.

My land is only 2.2 mu, so I cannot waste anything, but I also cannot take risks. Two people eat from this field plus what we sell. I do the same rotation every year — winter wheat then summer maize right after. That is what everyone in our village does, and it works.

**For wheat (winter):**
Last October I planted about 15 kg seed per mu of the improved variety the agro-shop sells — Jimai or something like that, same one my neighbor Old Wang uses, he had good harvest. I already sowed it back in October with the base fertilizer, so I am now thinking about top dressing in spring.

For base fertilizer I used 2 bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15, 40 kg bag) per mu — that is 80 kg per mu. Sounds like a lot but the soil here is tired, and if I skimp the wheat turns yellow. Then at green-up in spring (around now, maybe a bit later) I will put 1 bag of urea per mu, about 20-25 kg. That urea is for the wheat to grow tall and put out good heads.

Irrigation: I use the well. Winter water before freeze (already done), then green-up water, jointing water, and one more at grain filling. So about 3-4 times. Without water here the wheat is nothing.

Pesticide: I spray 2 times — once for aphids at heading, once if red mold shows up. Maybe a weed spray too in early spring. Call it 3 sprays total.

Till: after maize I use rotary tiller (hire the machine from the village, about 40 yuan per mu), then sow.

Expected yield: my field gives about 450 kg per mu of wheat in a good year. I plan for that.

**For maize (summer):**
After wheat harvest in June I sow maize directly — no till, just push the seed in. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu, whatever the shop has that year, about 2 kg seed per mu.

Fertilizer: I put 1 bag compound (40 kg) per mu at sowing, then 1 bag urea (about 25 kg) per mu at big trumpet stage. Maize eats a lot of nitrogen. If I see it going yellow I add a bit more urea.

Irrigation: summer has rain usually, so I only water 1-2 times if dry spell comes. Last year I watered twice.

Pesticide: one for armyworm or borer, maybe one for weeds early on. 2 sprays.

Expected: 550 kg per mu usually. If rain is good maybe 600.

I do not want to change much. My way works. Fertilizer price keeps going up but I would rather pay than get a small harvest — one bad harvest and my whole year is ruined.
